scripts.dev: npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 preview
scripts.dev:no-open: npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 preview --no-open
scripts.check: npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 lint && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 validate && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 inspect
scripts.snapshot: npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 snapshot --frames 8
scripts.render:draft: npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 render --fps 30 --quality draft --output renders/preview/draft.mp4
scripts.render:review: npm run prepare:sources && npm run build && npx --yes hyperframes@0.7.49 render --fps 60 --quality high --output renders/preview/review.mp4
